changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Track entity revisions also cover their stored geometry variants. No data backfill.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER gps_track_geometry_insert_revision AFTER INSERT ON gps_track_data REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_geometry FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION revise_tracks_after_geometry_change();

CREATE TRIGGER gps_track_geometry_update_revision AFTER UPDATE ON gps_track_data REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_geometry NEW TABLE AS new_geometry FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION revise_tracks_after_geometry_change();
CREATE TRIGGER gps_track_geometry_delete_revision AFTER DELETE ON gps_track_data REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_geometry FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION revise_tracks_after_geometry_change();
